items.title: Submarine Cable Resilience Faces Growing Threats From Aging Fleets and Concentrated Ownership
items.summary: Submarine cables underpin global communications, yet shipping accidents, sabotage risks and aging repair fleets threaten their resilience. Growing private ownership and fragmented international oversight raise difficult questions about infrastructure security, maintenance and accountability.

items.title: SpaceX Agrees to Acquire Nationwide 800 MHz Spectrum for Starlink Mobile
items.summary: SpaceX has agreed to acquire nationwide 800 MHz spectrum licenses from Grain Management in a deal reportedly worth $8 billion, potentially expanding Starlink Mobile's ability to integrate satellite and terrestrial connectivity.
